explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 60 named tracks, releases, reviews and catalogue references across live September 2026 Juno, Resident Advisor and Bandcamp windows; Guy From Downstairs' current self-released EP; REZZETT's current expanded jam archive; and fresh current-canonical inside-out boundaries. Written metadata and attributed descriptions only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Runs 169–192 artist and release fields were not recycled. Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, prior unresolved titles, unselected alternates and exact utility-ledger identities were excluded.
The immediately prior Peace World, Damage Music and Cold Blow fields were excluded, as were all recorded Max F, Alexander Kowalski and Type-303 identities.
The scan covered current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue material. Nine exact-title leads survived without padding.
Every placement pair was re-derived from the current 52-track ledger and checked for adjacency. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer sequence remains untouched.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
rankedLeadSummary: 3. Guy From Downstairs — The Son Of Knuf
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Juno and specialist retailers supplied Guy From Downstairs' September 4, 2026 four-track EP, exact tracklist and track-level construction notes. https://www.juno.co.uk/ · https://www.selectedwax.com/products/guy-from-downstairs-the-son-of-knuf-gfd012-vinyl-12

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Guy From Downstairs' self-operated GFD label and current four-track range supplied a groove-rooted field that crosses tempos, frequencies, 808-led club language and dub-techno framing.

OVERLOOKED / EXPANDED CATALOGUE WINDOW: REZZETT's official June 26, 2026 digital expansion supplied exact titles and durations from three years of London/Estonia jams. https://rezzett.bandcamp.com/album/into-the-boiling-darks
